question: How can an employee submit a leave request?

results.title: Employee Leave Policy
results.text: Employees may use sick leave when they are unable to work because of illness. For an extended absence, the employee may be asked to provide appropriate supporting documentation according to company procedures. ## Emergency Leave Emergency leave may be requested when an unexpected personal or family situation requires immediate attention. Employees should inform their manager as soon as reasonably possible. ## Leave Request Process Employees should submit leave requests through the approved internal leave system. The request should include the requested dates and the type of leave.

results.title: Employee Leave Policy
results.text: Employees should submit leave requests through the approved internal leave system. The request should include the requested dates and the type of leave. question: How should employees handle confidential company information?

results.text: TechNova Solutions aims to maintain a workplace where employees can work without harassment, intimidation, discrimination, or inappropriate behavior. Disagreements should be handled constructively and escalated through the appropriate channels when necessary. ## Confidential Information Employees may have access to company, customer, or project information as part of their responsibilities.
